title: Framer platform bento
description: A two-line title and grey sub-line over a hairline bento: one rounded black panel split by 1px lines into tall, wide and small cells, each holding a dark UI shot that fades out towards its edge and a white "Name →" label in its bottom-left corner. Three columns on desktop, one on phones.
notes: cell sizes: tall (1×2), wide (2×2), small (1×1) on a 3-column grid of 240px rows; on phones tall and wide cells are 480px, small ones 320px
each cell's media is a slot; empty it shows a placeholder placed like the original's shot (inset, bleeding off the right, or filling the cell)
